item.tib: dzA this drag po'i bka' srung nyi pang sad kyi mchod bskul
item.coloph: de ltar sngags kyi bstan srungs (srung) nyi pang sad kyi/ mchod bskul ni tshe dbang bdag gis sbyar/ rjes 'jug gshen gyi nyams len d+ha ris bris/ zhang zhung sgo yi phyogs la gter du sbos/ ma 'ongs yongs su dar ba'i smon lam thob/ sa ma ya// rgya rgya rgya phyis su phug leb 'o ma stag rtse nas dngos grub rnyed pa'o//
